title: FAQ: Who is eligible for the Power Plan Family Group feature?
text:
Question: Who is eligible for the Power Plan Family Group feature?
Answer: This feature is available for Mobile Postpaid customers who are on eligible Power Plan packages (Power Plan 2100 / 3500).

title: FAQ: What are the available Family group options?
text:
Question: What are the available Family group options?
Answer: Power Plan 2100 supports up to 2 supplementary connections and a maximum group size of 3. Power Plan 3500 supports up to 4 supplementary connections and a maximum group size of 5. Available combinations are: Family of 2 = primary member + 1 supplementary member; Family of 3 = primary member + 2 supplementary members; Family of 4 = Power Plan 3500 primary member + 3 supplementary members; Family of 5 = Power Plan 3500 primary member + 4 supplementary members.

title: FAQ: What benefits do supplementary members receive?
text:
Question: What benefits do supplementary members receive?
Answer: Supplementary members will be assigned a special Rs. 800 + tax package that includes unlimited any-net voice, 1000 any-net SMS, and 15GB anytime data. The 15GB is added to the group's sharable data bucket.

title: FAQ: Can I share data within the group?
text:
Question: Can I share data within the group?
Answer: Yes. The group's sharable data includes the primary member's anytime quota plus 15GB from each supplementary connection.

title: FAQ: How do I add members to my Family Group?
text:
Question: How do I add members to my Family Group?
Answer: Both primary and supplementary members must be on the same NIC and have the same billing cycle. Supplementary members will be automatically migrated to the Rs. 800 + tax plan upon successful addition.

title: FAQ: What happens if a supplementary member is removed?
text:
Question: What happens if a supplementary member is removed?
Answer: Once removed, the supplementary number is migrated to the Rs. 900 + tax Blaster plan and their 15GB group data allocation will be revoked.

title: FAQ: Can I change the primary member or their package after creating the group?
text:
Question: Can I change the primary member or their package after creating the group?
Answer: No. Once a group is created, the primary member and package cannot be changed unless the group is dissolved.

title: FAQ: What happens if a connection is temporarily disconnected?
text:
Question: What happens if a connection is temporarily disconnected?
Answer: Both primary and supplementary members must reconnect their numbers before proceeding with group creation or changes.

title: FAQ: Can a number be part of another sharing group at the same time?
text:
Question: Can a number be part of another sharing group at the same time?
Answer: No. A member must leave any existing data share group before joining or creating a Power Plan Family Group.

title: FAQ: When is the 15GB data allocated and how long is it valid?
text:
Question: When is the 15GB data allocated and how long is it valid?
Answer: 15GB is added only after the group is successfully created and is valid for 30 days. It renews with each billing cycle.

title: FAQ: Who is eligible to create or join a Friend Circle?
text:
Question: Who is eligible to create or join a Friend Circle?
Answer: Any customer on one of the eligible Power Plan packages: Power Plan 1300, Power Plan 2100, or Power Plan 3500.

title: FAQ: What benefits do Primary and Supplementary members receive?
text:
Question: What benefits do Primary and Supplementary members receive?
Answer: Primary Member: 10GB bonus data monthly and a 10% Power Plan rental discount each month. Supplementary Members: a 10% Power Plan rental discount each month.

title: FAQ: When are benefits applied?
text:
Question: When are benefits applied?
Answer: Benefits are allocated automatically once two supplementary members have been successfully added and the group is created.

title: FAQ: Can I remove a member or delete the group?
text:
Question: Can I remove a member or delete the group?
Answer: Yes. The primary member can remove any supplementary member via the MyDialog App. Once one member is removed, the group is deleted and all benefits end.

title: FAQ: What happens if a member's connection is disconnected?
text:
Question: What happens if a member's connection is disconnected?
Answer: All group benefits are removed immediately. When the disconnected member reconnects, benefits resume from the time of reconnection.

title: FAQ: Can I change my package after forming a Friend Circle?
text:
Question: Can I change my package after forming a Friend Circle?
Answer: Package changes to non-eligible plans are restricted while any members remain in the Friend Circle. Postpaid-to-prepaid conversions are also prohibited. Package changes are allowed between eligible packages.

title: FAQ: How often can the 10GB bonus data be awarded?
text:
Question: How often can the 10GB bonus data be awarded?
Answer: The 10GB bonus is a one-time offer per primary member. Removing and re-adding members or forming new groups will not trigger additional bonuses. For the primary user, the 10GB bonus data is valid for 30 days and will be renewed as long as the group remains active.

title: FAQ: Is there a deadline to collect my pre-ordered Air Fibre device?
text:

Customers who did not collect their device by the deadline will receive an automatic refund of the Rs. 2,490 advance payment to the original account or card used for payment. Refunds will be processed by 25 September 2026. The Rs. 2,500 Early Bird Discount expired on 25 August 2026 and is no longer applicable.

title: FAQ: What is the process to collect my Air Fibre pre-ordered device?
text:
Question: What is the process to collect my Air Fibre pre-ordered device?
Answer: Step 1: Visit the selected Dialog Experience Centre, where coverage will be verified and available Air Fibre packages will be explained. After selecting a package, make the balance payment and confirm the order. Step 2: Once the order is confirmed, a technical team will schedule a premises visit within 48 hours to identify the optimal router location and assess service performance. If coverage is sufficient, installation and activation will proceed. If the technical assessment determines that 5G coverage is insufficient, installation will not proceed and the full payment will be refunded within 7 working days.

title: FAQ: Why can't I collect the device directly at the outlet without a two-step coverage validation?
text:
Question: Why can't I collect the device directly at the outlet without a two-step coverage validation?
Answer: Dialog Air Fibre operates on the 5G network and service performance can vary by location. A home assessment is performed to identify the optimal router placement, verify indoor Wi-Fi coverage, and confirm that the service can provide reliable connectivity before activation.

title: FAQ: What is Air Fibre and how is it different from current 4G Wi-Fi?
text:
Question: What is Air Fibre and how is it different from current 4G Wi-Fi?
Answer: Air Fibre is a Wi-Fi solution that operates on the Dialog Mobile 5G network. It differs from current 4G Home Broadband because it runs on a 5G network and functions as a mobile-based connection.

title: FAQ: Why should I buy Air Fibre? What are the benefits?
text:
Question: Why should I buy Air Fibre? What are the benefits?
Answer: Air Fibre is designed to support smoother experiences such as augmented and virtual reality, lag-free gaming, better-quality streaming including live streaming, and multiple connected devices. Customers can also receive free content subscriptions through the Dialog Play app and exclusive offers.

title: FAQ: How can I check if Air Fibre is available at my location?
text:

Answer: You can check Air Fibre availability using Dialog's network coverage map or the MyDialog App.

title: FAQ: When will Air Fibre be available in my area if it's not currently covered?
text:
Question: When will Air Fibre be available in my area if it's not currently covered?
Answer: Air Fibre coverage is being expanded in phases as part of the 5G rollout. The network coverage map will be updated regularly as new areas are added.

title: FAQ: Are there any offers for customers to upgrade to Air Fibre?
text:

Answer: Club Vision customers may be eligible for exclusive benefits when subscribing to Dialog Air Fibre. Eligible offers and discounts will be communicated according to Dialog's prevailing eligibility criteria and promotional guidelines.

title: FAQ: How can I upgrade my existing Home Wi-Fi connection to Air Fibre?
text:
Question: How can I upgrade my existing Home Wi-Fi connection to Air Fibre?
Answer: You cannot directly upgrade an existing Home Wi-Fi connection to Air Fibre. A new Air Fibre connection is required.

title: FAQ: Can I use the Air Fibre device in a non-Air Fibre coverage area?
text:
Question: Can I use the Air Fibre device in a non-Air Fibre coverage area?
Answer: Air Fibre is designed for use within designated coverage areas. If the device is moved outside the location validated during installation, 5G service may be limited or unavailable, internet speeds and service performance may be affected, and service quality cannot be guaranteed. For best performance, use the device at the validated installation location.

title: FAQ: How long does it take to install Air Fibre?
text:
Question: How long does it take to install Air Fibre?
Answer: Once an order is confirmed, Dialog's technical team will visit the premises within 48 hours to perform the required service assessment. After successful validation, installation and activation will be completed.

title: FAQ: If I have not pre-ordered an Air Fibre device, how can I make a new purchase?
text:

Answer: Visit a Dialog Experience Centre, select a preferred monthly plan, make the full payment, and confirm the order. A technical team will visit within 48 hours. If service performance is confirmed, installation and activation will proceed. If 5G coverage is insufficient, installation will not proceed and the full payment will be refunded within 7 working days.

title: FAQ: What is the Blaster Fixed Voice Unlimited Package?
text:
Question: What is the Blaster Fixed Voice Unlimited Package?

title: Dialog Global Roaming Data Passport
text:
Overview:
Dialog Global Data Passport delivers predictable, capped daily and weekly international data rates for Sri Lankan travelers going abroad. It replaces unpredictable pay-as-you-go data roaming fees with fixed daily buckets that activate automatically upon connection with foreign partner carriers.

Roaming Rates & Tiers:
- Daily Roaming Passport: USD 5.00 per day (+ local telecom taxes) for 2 GB high-speed daily data.
- Weekly Roaming Passport: USD 25.00 for 7 days, including 15 GB high-speed roaming data.
- Pay-As-You-Go Standard Rate (without Passport): USD 0.15 per MB.
- Outgoing Roaming Voice: USD 0.60 per minute to Sri Lanka; USD 0.40 per minute for local in-country calls.
- Incoming Roaming Voice: USD 0.30 per minute across all partner networks.

Activation Steps:
1. Ensure international roaming is activated on your SIM profile prior to departing Sri Lanka.
2. Dial #107# from your phone while in Sri Lanka or overseas.
3. Select option 1 'Roaming Services' -> Select 'Data Passports'.
4. Choose either '1-Day Unlimited Passport' or '7-Day Business Passport'.
5. Once your flight lands abroad, turn on 'Data Roaming' in your smartphone's Cellular/Mobile Data settings.

Best for: Business executives, corporate travelers, and vacationers traveling overseas who require reliable mobile maps, email, and messaging without bill shock.

 a. Access smartphone Settings -> Mobile Data.

title: Troubleshooting Guide: Resolving 'No Service' or Emergency Calls Only
text:
Overview:
When your mobile phone displays 'No Service', 'Emergency Calls Only', or an empty signal bar indicator, follow these technical troubleshooting steps to restore communication with the Dialog network.

Step-by-Step Resolution:

1. Toggle Airplane Mode:
 Swipe down the notification shade (Android) or Control Center (iOS) and turn on Airplane Mode. Wait 15 seconds, then turn it off. This forces the device baseband processor to clear stale network tables and initiate a fresh handshake with nearby towers.

2. Reboot the Device:
 Power down your phone completely for 30 seconds and restart it. This resets cellular radio firmware and re-reads the SIM card encryption keys.

3. Verify Physical SIM Placement:
 Eject the SIM tray using a SIM-ejector tool. Inspect the golden contact pins on the SIM card for physical scratches, dirt, or dust. Gently wipe the chip using a clean, dry microfiber cloth and reseat it securely in the tray.

4. Check Manual Network Selection:
 Navigate to Settings -> Mobile Networks -> Network Operators. Toggle off 'Automatic' and wait for the carrier list to populate. Select 'Dialog' or '413 02' (Dialog PLMN code). Once connected, return the toggle back to 'Automatic'.

5. Test SIM in Another Handset:
 Insert your SIM into another unlocked mobile device. If signal is restored immediately, your phone's internal antenna or modem hardware may require service. If the second phone also shows 'No Service', visit a Dialog service outlet for a complimentary SIM replacement.

title: Troubleshooting Guide: Resolving Slow Mobile Internet Speeds
text:
Overview:
If your mobile data connection feels sluggish, apps fail to load promptly, or videos buffer repeatedly, follow this structured diagnostic guide to optimize and restore your data speeds.

Step-by-Step Resolution:

1. Check Data Allowance & Fair Usage Status:
 Dial #170# or launch the MyDialog app to confirm that your anytime high-speed data quota is not exhausted. If you have crossed your monthly Fair Usage Policy (FUP) limit, standard throttling (e.g., 512 Kbps or 5 Mbps) applies until renewal.

2. Verify Access Point Name (APN) Settings:
 Go to Settings -> Mobile Network -> Access Point Names. Ensure that the active APN is configured correctly:
 - Name: Dialog Internet
 - APN: dialogbb (for postpaid and prepaid)
 - Proxy / Port: Not set (leave blank)
 - APN Protocol: IPv4/IPv6
 Save changes and select this profile as default.

3. Toggle Preferred Network Mode:
 Open Settings -> Mobile Network -> Preferred Network Type. If set to '3G Only' or '2G/3G Auto', change it to '5G/4G/3G/2G Auto' or 'LTE/WCDMA'. If connected to a heavily congested 4G tower, temporarily locking your device to '3G Only' can sometimes bypass bottlenecked cells for basic web browsing.

4. Clear App Cache and Reset Network Settings:
 Clear cache on lagging applications. If overall device throughput remains poor, execute a network reset: Settings -> General Management / System -> Reset -> Reset Network Settings (note: this clears saved Wi-Fi passwords).

title: Troubleshooting Guide: Resolving SMS Sending and Receiving Failures
text:
Overview:
Short Message Service (SMS) failures prevent sending personal texts and receiving two-factor authentication (2FA) banking OTP codes. Use this guide to resolve SMS transmission errors.

Step-by-Step Resolution:

1. Verify the SMS Center (SMSC) Number:
 An incorrect SMSC number stored on the SIM card will block outgoing text dispatch.
 - For Android: Open Messages -> Settings -> More Settings -> Text Messages -> SMS Center.
 - Ensure the number is set exactly to: +9477000003
 - If field is missing, open phone dialer, type *#*#4636#*#*, select Phone Information, locate SMSC, enter "+9477000003" and press Update.
 - For iPhone: Open Phone app, dial *5005*7672*+9477000003# and press Call.

2. Check Account Balance / Credit Limit:
 For prepaid users, verify balance (*#456#) to ensure you have at least LKR 2.50 to cover standard SMS fees if not covered by a bundle. For postpaid users, check if your credit limit has been breached.

3. Clear SMS App Storage Cache:
 Navigate to Settings -> Apps -> Messages -> Storage -> Clear Cache. Restart the messaging app.

4. Verify Blocked Numbers and Premium SMS Permissions:
 Check Settings -> Apps -> Special App Access -> Premium SMS access -> Ensure 'Always Allow' is selected. Check device Spam and Blocked lists to make sure the recipient number is not inadvertently filtered.

title: Troubleshooting Guide: Unable to Place or Receive Voice Calls
text:
Overview:
When outbound voice calls disconnect immediately with tones such as 'Call Ended', fast busy beeps, or incoming calls route straight to voicemail without ringing, follow this sequence of diagnostic steps.

Step-by-Step Resolution:

1. Check Outgoing Call Barring Settings:
 Ensure call barring has not been activated on your line. Dial the standard GSM cancellation code: #33*0000# and press Call. This deactivates all outgoing barring restrictions using the default factory PIN (0000).

2. Verify Call Forwarding Status:
 If inbound callers report reaching voicemail or a dead line, disable forwarding diversions:
 - Dial ##002# and press Send. This cancels all conditional and unconditional call diverts.

3. Enable or Disable VoLTE (Voice over LTE):
 Voice calls in modern networks require VoLTE. Navigate to Settings -> Mobile Networks -> VoLTE Calls -> Toggle ON. If VoLTE is already on and calls drop, toggle it OFF temporarily to route calls through standard 3G/2G circuit-switched fallback.

4. Inspect Credit Balance and Outstanding Dues:
 Prepaid customers: Dial #456# to verify account balance.
 Postpaid customers: Dial #145# to check credit limit status. If your credit limit has been exceeded, outgoing calls are suspended until an interim payment is settled.

5. Check 'Do Not Disturb' (DND) and Caller ID Settings:
 Verify that 'Do Not Disturb' or Focus mode is turned off. Under Phone App Settings -> Additional Settings -> Caller ID -> ensure it is set to 'Network Default' or 'Show Number', as hiding your caller ID can cause carrier firewalls to reject outbound calls.

title: Troubleshooting Guide: Device Displays 'No SIM Card Detected'
text:
Overview:
When your smartphone displays 'No SIM', 'Insert SIM', or shows a SIM icon marked with an exclamation mark, the operating system hardware interface cannot establish an electrical connection with the chip.

Step-by-Step Resolution:

1. Clean and Re-insert the SIM Card:
 Power down your phone completely before opening the tray. Eject the SIM holder carefully. Check for physical debris, lint, or moisture. Take a soft rubber pencil eraser or microfiber cloth and gently rub the metallic contact pads to remove oxidized residue. Re-seat the card firmly into the tray indentations and slide it back in gently without forcing.

2. Inspect for Physical Damage:
 Examine the card under good lighting. If the SIM is cracked, noticeably warped, bent, or if the plastic surrounding the copper contact is chipped, the internal microchip bond wire is broken and the SIM must be replaced.

3. Test Secondary Slot or Alternate Device:
 If your phone has Dual SIM capabilities, insert the SIM card into SIM Slot 2. If Slot 2 recognizes the card, Slot 1's internal connector pins may be damaged or bent. Alternatively, test the SIM in a different phone to isolate whether the fault lies with the SIM card or the phone hardware.

4. Obtain a SIM Replacement (Same Number):
 If the SIM is unresponsive across multiple devices, visit any Dialog Experience Center or authorized franchisee. Bring your National Identity Card (NIC) or Passport. A replacement SIM card can be issued within 10 minutes, retaining your current phone number, package balance, and account history for a nominal fee of LKR 150 (free of charge for high-tier club members).
